title: Chapter 358 Gathering At Red Copper Mountain
content:
Chapter 358 Gathering At Red Copper Mountain

Wang Shuo sneered.

Soon everyone came to the edge of a teleportation array.

"There are six teleportation arrays in Yingying Town. Each time you teleport, even if it is the same teleportation array, you can only teleport to a temporary shelter in the same area. I will tell you the meeting place now. When the time comes, everyone will go to the meeting place in the wild as quickly as possible."

Wang Shuo also felt that this teleportation mechanism was quite good and avoided the possibility of stalking and killing people.

"Everyone, the gathering time is only 1 hour. After 1 hour, if you haven't arrived at the gathering place, we won't wait."

If you haven't arrived yet after the time limit, it is most likely that you have encountered danger, and there is really no need to wait any longer.

Wang Shuo, together with more than ten other people, stepped onto the teleportation array.

The scene in front of him changed, and Wang Shuo came to a temporary shelter in the wild.

It was the shelter he teleported to for the first time.

Wang Shuo compared the direction and walked towards a mountain in the distance.

After staying in the wild for a while, Wang Shuo was also experienced.

He immediately summoned Da Huang. In the wild, with Da Huang, many unnecessary dangers can be avoided.

Since I learned in the Treasure Pavilion that there are many precious herbs in the wild.

Along the way, Wang Shuo paid attention.

He really found a lot, but they were all ordinary goods, not the top-level herbs.

But Wang Shuo still collected them all and put them in his backpack.

Wang Cuilian did not tell everyone the specific location of the ruins.

She just gave a general direction.

The gathering place was at the foot of the Red Copper Mountain west of Yingying Town.

The Red Copper Mountain is more than 2,000 meters above sea level, which is not very high.

There are rich red copper mines in the mountain. There are few vegetation on the mountain, and there are many places with exposed red ore.

Wang Shuo came to the agreed shelter at the foot of the mountain, and a teammate was already waiting there.

Wang Shuo did not remember his name, but he had a general impression that this person was his teammate.

He went up and said hello.

"Hello, you're here quite early!"

"I just happened to be teleported here, but your mount is pretty good!"

The man looked at Wang Shuo and said casually, without any other expression on his face.

The two chatted awkwardly for a few sentences, and then they lost interest in talking. They each found a place and waited for others silently.

After a while, Wang Shuo saw several groups of people passing by them.

Wang Shuo looked at the passers-by vigilantly, keeping a distance from each other, and did not fight at the slightest disagreement.

These people are probably also people who got the news and want to explore the ruins.

At this time, overlooking Chitong Mountain.

There are military generals gathering everywhere.

The small ones form teams of several people.

The large ones have dozens or hundreds of people.

The largest ones are naturally the Songjiang Gang led by Jiang Song, the White Tiger Hall led by Zuo Da, the Treasure Pavilion led by Baichuan Zhonggu, and the Colosseum led by Xi Wenhua.

At the place where they gathered, hundreds of people have gathered.

Among them, each faction has several top-level generals, and their combat power is quite terrifying.

Half an hour later, Wang Cuilian and others arrived one after another.

When they gathered before, there were as many as 15 people.

At this time, there were only 9 people gathered.

If these people had not encountered danger on the way, they would have switched to other forces.

The temporary team is like this and can leave at any time.

"It seems that we are the only ones left." Swan said with some disappointment.

At this time, Song Bo and his three friends, who had not been seen for a long time, passed by in a hurry.

He turned his head and saw everyone, and then walked over.

"What a coincidence!"

"Hey, Brother Song, you are here for the ruins too, right!?" Wang Cuilian said with a smile.

"Yes! Are you forming a team?"

"Well, Brother Song, are you interested in joining?"

Song Bo looked at everyone, his eyes stayed on Wang Shuo, and then said with a smile: "It just so happens that I don't have a team yet, so let's join together!"

Wang Shuo was a little unhappy, but it was not easy to stop him.
